summary: W4 Re-audit of cilium-cli v0.19.4 after P1/P2/P3 fixes. All 5 previously found issues have been verified as resolved in the updated changed_files content: (1) P1 R3-forged-status: both version-level and software-level manifest.yaml now consistently show status 'built' (not 'published'); (2) P2 CS-7-safe-mode: test.sh now starts with 'set -euo pipefail'; (3) P2 CS-16-import-order: 'import platform' is now at the top of conanfile.py in the standard library import block, not inside a method; (4) P3 CS-1-file-header: test_package/conanfile.py now has '#!/usr/bin/env python3' shebang on line 1; (5) P3 R34-substantive-test: test.sh now validates version string content using 'cilium version 2>&1 | grep -q "v0.19.4"'. No new P0 or P1 issues were found during the re-audit. The conanfile.py follows Conan 2.x API conventions, has proper class naming (CiliumCliConan), correct package_type='application', proper method ordering, and sets cpp_info.bindirs. The test.sh invokes the built cilium binary and performs substantive validation. commands.json, conandata.yml, and both manifest.yaml files are all consistent and compliant. Verdict: PASS.
